integrity: Exact edge-intersection and spherical-Haar proof for all parameters, with reproducible independent finite checks. Numerical sampling is corroboration and not the proof. All source dates use the first verified public record; the 2013 journal record is dated 13 July 2013.
scientific_limitations: Only Haar-uniform central sections of even regular polygonal prisms with at least six base sides; no conclusion for randomly offset cuts, odd bases, irregular prisms or complete section face vectors. Historical priority remains provisional outside the specifically inspected sources.
title: A unique maximal-section optimizer for every even regular polygonal prism
